environment.description: Node.js 18 Apollo Server deployed on EC2 instance. PostgreSQL 14 on RDS. The DB_USER is 'appservice' which has been granted full privileges (SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE) on the 'users' table via: GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON TABLE users TO appservice. No WAF or query filtering in front of the GraphQL endpoint. Direct internet-facing ALB with no managed rule groups attached.

config.db_permissions: GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON TABLE users TO appservice
